NANOBOT_WEB_TOKEN.title: WebUI password
NANOBOT_WEB_TOKEN.description: Signs you into the public WebUI. First boot stores it in config.json on the volume; changing it later needs a redeploy.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.title: Anthropic API key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Any provider can also be configured later in WebUI Settings -> Models.

NANOBOT_CHANNELS.title: Channels baked into the image
NANOBOT_CHANNELS.description: Comma-separated, e.g. telegram,slack. Leave empty to install a channel's dependencies the first time it is enabled.
